prompt:
Write a short paragraph summarising the meeting transcript
below. Cover the decisions that were made, the owner of each action, and any
dates mentioned.

Transcript:
Weekly platform sync, 12 March.
Priya: the ingest queue backed up twice last week, both times after the 02:00 batch.
Raj: I traced it to the retry policy — failed jobs requeue instantly and starve new ones.
Priya: can we put a backoff on it?
Raj: yes, exponential with a cap at five minutes. Half a day of work.
Priya: do it this sprint. Raj owns it, due Friday the 20th.
Dana: separately, we agreed to postpone the Kafka upgrade until after the audit.
Priya: agreed. Revisit in April.
Dana: I will tell the infra team so they stop holding a window for it.


Summary:
response: The meeting discussed two actions. Priya noted that the ingest queue was backed up twice last week, both after the 02:00 batch, and Raj traced it to the retry policy, which requeues jobs instantly and starves new ones. Priya suggested a backoff policy with a cap of five minutes and a half-day of work, and Raj confirmed the plan. Priya also mentioned that the action should be completed by Friday the 20th, with Raj owning it. Meanwhile, Dana agreed to postpone the Kafka upgrade until after the audit, which will be revisited in April. Dana also confirmed that the infra team will stop holding a window for the upgrade.
